text:
incident-bot: PAGER: P0 - eu-west-1 embeddings high tail latency and intermittent 5xxs. Triggered at 2026-03-17 09:20 UTC. Oncall: @priya. Channel #incidents created.

priya: I'm on it. Joining call now. Can someone grab the autoscaler events and recent node logs?

ashley: logs uploaded to gs://redwood-incident/eu-embeddings/3618000000/logs.txt and a quick grafana snapshot: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/EU_EMBEDDINGS/overview

raj: quick hypothesis: autoscaler oscillation + cold starts for quantized kernels. Seeing repeated scale-up/scale-down cycles starting ~09:12.

maria: Support is seeing customer reports of increased 429/502s. We should draft a short statuspage entry. Draft below, please review: 

---
Initial status (draft):
Component: Embeddings (eu-west-1)
Impact: Increased latency and intermittent errors for embeddings API in eu-west-1. Some requests may return 5xx or time out.
Customer guidance: Retry after 30s; fallback to other region via regional routing config.
Timeline: We are investigating root cause and implementing mitigation to stabilize capacity.
Next update: in 15 minutes or when we have a mitigation to report.
---

priya: change "retry after 30s" -> "retry after 30s with jitter" and add support contact link. Also add a line clarifying no customer data exposure.

sam: lgtm w/ those edits. Also suggest adding: we are increasing reserved capacity as immediate mitigation.

ops-bot: Suggested edit applied: added 'no customer data exposure' sentence and note about reserved capacity.

maria: Updated draft below. Does everyone approve to publish initial update?

---
Initial status:
Embeddings (eu-west-1): Increased tail latency and intermittent 5xx errors impacting embeddings generation. We are actively investigating and deploying capacity-stability mitigations. No customer data exposure suspected.
Workaround: Retry with jitter or use other regions; contact support at support@redwood.ai for high-priority incidents.
We will post an update within 15 minutes or when we have more info.
---

ashley: :thumbsup: publish when ready.

priya: publishing now. @ops-bot kick statuspage publish workflow.

ops-bot: statuspage update published: https://status.redwood.ai/incident/3618000000 - initial update live.

raj: mitigation in flight: increased min pool size by 2 and disabled aggressive downscale policy in eu-west-1; traffic appears to be stabilizing.

priya: monitoring metrics — p95 down from ~1.8s -> ~0.9s after change. Continuing observation.

maria: Drafting follow-up update to include metrics snapshot and next steps (posting at +15m). Draft below: 

---
Update 1 (15 minutes):
We increased reserved capacity to limit autoscaler oscillation. P95 latency has improved from ~1.8s to ~0.9s. Error rate reduced by ~70%. We're continuing monitoring and will implement a long-term autoscaler policy tweak.
---

ashley: minor wording: replace "reducing scaling churn" with "to limit autoscaler oscillation". Otherwise approve.

maria: applied wording change. Approve?

sam: approve.

ops-bot: posted update 1: https://status.redwood.ai/incident/3618000000?update=1

priya: looks stable for 30m. I'll keep oncall for monitoring and plan handover at 10:00 UTC, marking as 'monitoring'.

maria: Drafting resolved notice for when we finish validation. Draft below: 

---
Resolved:
Issue: Autoscaler oscillation in eu-west-1 causing transient latency spikes and errors for embeddings.
Resolution: We adjusted autoscaler thresholds and increased minimum capacity, preventing abrupt downscales. Metrics: Latency returned to normal levels and error rates returned to baseline.
Impact: Some requests between 09:20–09:55 UTC may have experienced errors or increased latency. No data exposure.
If you continue to see issues, contact support@redwood.ai.
---

priya: approve resolved wording. ops-bot: publish resolve when ready.

ops-bot: resolved notice published: https://status.redwood.ai/incident/3618000000/resolved

maria: closing thread. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:

priya: handing off monitoring to the next oncall, will follow up in post-incident review doc.

ashley: adding links to incident runbook and postmortem checklist in the incident channel.

ops-bot: incident channel archived for follow-up notes.
